name: Avoma
summary: Meeting assistant and conversation intelligence for sales teams.
description: Avoma records, transcribes and summarizes calls and video meetings, then updates the CRM with notes and action items. It also analyzes conversations for rep coaching and deal tracking.

howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.
